text: Defined simulate_simple_dataset SNR as empirical SD(clean signals)/SD(complete structured noise), scaling the complete noise realization rather than ARMA innovations alone. Reusing the same seed now preserves events, clean signal, and standardized noise while varying only noise scale. Physiology uses continuous 1.1 Hz cardiac and 0.3 Hz respiratory signals, sampled at TR=2 into distinct 0.1/0.2 Hz aliases.
